repos_data.description: Fake server, Consumer Driven Contracts and help with testing performance from one configuration file with zero system dependencies and no coding whatsoever
The API-change deploy gate for AI coding agents (MCP server): is it safe to ship this API change to my consumers? Read-only, over OpenAPI/Pact.

repo_meta_data.description: JVM version of Pact. Enables consumer driven contract testing, providing a mock service and DSL for the consumer project, and interaction playback and verification for the service provider project.
